outcomes_added.question_summary: Find the three-digit integer \(abc\) whose base-9 representation is \(bca_9\).
outcomes_added.observation: The model correctly set up the equation relating the decimal number \(100a + 10b + c\) to its base-9 representation \(81b + 9c + a\), then systematically searched for digit values that satisfy the equation.
